metadata.description: Agent Skills from SONUB (sonub.com) — standard SKILL.md skills that work in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI and other agents.

plugins.name: gp
plugins.description: Manage all your work in GitHub Projects (v2) with the gh CLI — boards, kanban columns, fields, views, issues, images, TODO checklists, assignees. Works in Claude Code cloud sessions too (REST gh api + a gp-sync Action for the board).

plugins.name: cc-skill
plugins.description: Learn and master Claude Code — a study track with exercises and quizzes, answers checked against the live docs, a setup doctor, every CHANGELOG feature summarized, and `/claude-skill update` to pull new features into the skill.

plugins.name: popup
plugins.description: Explain jargon in any project with hover/tap popups — one glossary JSON (meaning, plain words, examples, code, related terms, learn-more links), a drop-in popup.js/css, a checker, a doc audit for undefined jargon, and Markdown hover links for READMEs.
